en: Multi-view color postcard showing the spa town of Borsec in winter (and one summer scene). It features snow-covered streets, villas and hotels with people walking, tall fir trees, and a stone pavilion at a mineral spring. In the center is a yellow roundel with a small coat of arms and large red lettering that reads BORSEC. The reverse has Romanian text, address fields, Romanian postage and Borsec/București postmarks.
